data.verdict: SADDLE-OFFSET PICTURE CONFIRMED AT THE DT LIMIT [scope-(a)], q=1 leg OPEN. Lifting the certified {3,4} Stokes data into a 2-D saddle vector v(q)=(c⁺,c⁻): chiral 5₂ has v(0)=(4,3) sitting OFF the classical (amphichiral) diagonal at angle 8.130° with ι-odd offset o(0) = c⁺−c⁻ = 1 — reproducing EXACTLY the ι-odd {3,4} difference (the merged distinguisher's chiralityOdd 4 3 = 1) as the SEMICLASSICAL (q→0) displacement of the saddle. Amphichiral 4₁ has v=(3,3) ON the diagonal, offset 0 — the winding is origin-centered exactly when the knot is bar-symmetric. The offset is q-DEPENDENT (o(q) = 1 −9q + …, not a constant): the saddle genuinely deforms with q — the 'winds near-but-not-on' picture, quantified. HONEST SCOPE: the 'origin-centered ONLY at q=1' leg is NOT established — the q→0-anchored certified series diverge at q=1, and o(q) is a cross-chirality DT datum (leading 1 ≠ 0), not shown to continue to 0 at the ι-fixed point q=1. That leg is a distinct, untested claim (beaned). No fit; no c_k wired; no axiomatization; nothing wired to production; scope-(a).
